title: Arkini game project source schema
description: A strict game.json root or one strict UID-owned item fragment.

meta.description: Core metadata and player-available layouts for this game.

resources.description: Explicit non-item resource roles used by the game shell.

start.description: The initial board, inventory, and toolbar contents created for a new game.

GameProjectFileSchema.title: Arkini game project root file
GameProjectFileSchema.description: The complete game.json contract excluding items owned by items/<type> files.

IdSchema.description: A non-empty exact identity used across Arkini.

PositiveIntegerSchema.description: A whole number greater than zero.

width.description: The positive number of grid cells arranged horizontally.

height.description: The positive number of grid cells arranged vertically.

GridSizeSchema.description: The explicit width and height of a two-dimensional game grid.

ToolbarSizeSchema.description: The optional toolbar slot count from zero through sixty-four.

id.description: The stable ID of this game configuration.

title.description: The human-readable title of this game.

board.description: The size of the board on which items are placed.

inventory.description: The size of the inventory grid available to the player.

toolbarSize.description: The optional one-row toolbar slot count; zero or undefined disables it.

MetaSchema.description: Core metadata and player-available layouts for a game.

hero.description: The explicit resource ID used by the game splash hero.

ResourceConfigSchema.description: Named non-item resource references required by the game.

NonNegativeIntegerSchema.description: A whole number greater than or equal to zero.

space.description: The explicit board space containing this initial item.

itemId.description: The canonical item ID placed on the initial board.

quantity.description: The optional stack quantity placed in this exact initial board cell; omitted means one.

start.BoardItemSchema.description: One canonical item placed at an explicit initial board coordinate.

itemId.description: The canonical item ID added to the initial inventory.

position.description: The exact initial inventory slot occupied by this stack.

quantity.description: The positive initial inventory quantity; defaults to one.

start.InventoryItemSchema.description: A positive quantity of one canonical item in the initial inventory.

PositionSchema.description: One zero-based position in a two-dimensional game grid.

itemId.description: The canonical item ID placed in the initial toolbar.

quantity.description: The optional stack quantity placed in this exact initial toolbar slot; omitted means one.

position.description: The exact zero-based initial toolbar slot.

start.ToolbarItemSchema.description: One canonical item placed at an explicit initial toolbar slot.

currentSpace.description: The board space presented when a new game starts.

board.description: The items placed at explicit coordinates when a new game starts.

inventory.description: The item quantities added to inventory when a new game starts.

toolbar.description: The items placed at explicit slots when a new game starts.

StartSchema.description: The initial board placements, inventory contents, and toolbar placements for a new game.

items.description: The single canonical item owned by this UID-named file.

GameProjectItemFileSchema.title: Arkini game project item file
GameProjectItemFileSchema.description: One item fragment stored at items/<type>/<encoded uid>.json.

ItemSchema.description: A game item selected by its type discriminator.

uid.description: The immutable CUID2 identity of this canonical game item.

id.description: The stable authoring ID of this canonical game item.

title.description: The human-readable title of this item.

description.description: The human-readable explanation of this item's purpose.

asset.description: The visual asset definition used to render this item.

scope.description: The part of game state in which this item may be stored.

maxCount.description: The optional maximum number of this item allowed across the game state.

maxStackSize.description: The maximum number of this item that one stack can hold before it has mutable state.

charges.description: The optional finite lifetime and depletion output of each item instance.

merge.description: The optional non-empty target-specific merges initiated when this item is dropped onto another item.

line.description: The one product line owned by this blueprint.

BlueprintItemSchema.description: A construction-blueprint configuration with one product line.

AssetCompositionSchema.description: A one- or two-layer visual asset composition in back-to-front order.

default.description: The default one- or two-layer visual composition in back-to-front order.

sources.description: The optional ordered single-layer progress states after the default.

AssetSchema.description: The visual asset definition for a game item.

StorageScopeEnumSchema.description: Where one canonical item may physically exist in grid state.

amount.description: The positive number of charges owned by every fresh item instance.

output.description: The optional output emitted exactly once when one item instance is depleted.

ChargeSchema.description: A finite item lifetime and optional output emitted on depletion.

set.description: One or more alternative roll sets provided by this output.

OutputSchema.description: A configured output produced by a gameplay source.

weight.description: The positive relative weight used to select this roll set.

roll.description: One or more rolls evaluated after this set is selected.

RollSetSchema.description: An alternative non-empty collection of output rolls.

RollSchema.description: A typed roll that an output may produce.

drop.description: One or more items emitted when this roll succeeds.

RollGuaranteedSchema.description: A roll that guarantees its output when its rules allow it.

itemId.description: The ID of the canonical game item emitted by this drop.

quantity.description: The quantity emitted by this drop.

placement.description: The board-placement strategy for this drop; defaults to a local Manhattan-distance drop and does not control scope-based inventory fallback.

rules.description: Rules evaluated after this drop is selected by a successful roll.

DropSchema.description: A canonical game item, quantity, board-placement strategy, and rules for a successful roll's drop.

min.description: The smallest quantity that may resolve.

max.description: The largest quantity that may resolve.

QuantitySchema.description: The inclusive positive bounds resolved by one quantity contract.

PlacementEnumSchema.description: How a resolved item drop chooses its board origin before canonical nearest-first placement, independently from inventory fallback.

DropRuleSchema.description: An availability rule evaluated for a selected drop.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this selected-drop rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this selected-drop rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as an enable gate for the selected drop.

DropRuleEnableSchema.description: A rule that enables a selected drop when its conditions pass.

WhenSchema.description: A standalone condition that evaluates an item-query quantity.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an item-query existence check.

WhenExistsSchema.description: A condition that checks whether an item query returns any quantity.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

scope.description: Identifies this query as a board-only query.

distance.description: The origin itself, an exact close or near Chebyshev distance, or any positive far distance.

QueryBoardSchema.description: A board-only item query constrained by a required board distance.

itemId.description: The stable ID of the selected canonical item.

SelectorSchema.description: A selector that resolves one canonical game item by stable ID.

DistanceEnumSchema.description: The source cell itself, an exact close or near Chebyshev distance, or any positive far distance.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

scope.description: Identifies this query as an inventory-only query.

QueryInventorySchema.description: An inventory-only item query without a board distance.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

scope.description: Identifies this query as a toolbar-only query.

QueryToolbarSchema.description: A toolbar-only item query without a board distance.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

scope.description: Identifies this query as one that searches the origin-space board, shared inventory, and toolbar.

QueryAnySchema.description: An item query that searches the origin-space board, shared inventory, and toolbar without a distance.

selector.description: The canonical item used to select query candidates.

scope.description: Searches every board space plus both passive storage surfaces.

QueryUniverseSchema.description: A universe-wide item query across every board space and both passive storage surfaces without distance.

QuerySchema.description: A board, exact passive-storage, local combined, or universe-wide item query selected by scope.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an exact item-query quantity check.

count.description: The exact item quantity that the query must return.

WhenCountSchema.description: A condition that checks an item query against one exact quantity.

query.description: The query used to find the items evaluated by this condition.

type.description: Identifies this condition as an inclusive item-query quantity range check.

min.description: The smallest item quantity accepted by this condition.

max.description: The largest item quantity accepted by this condition.

WhenRangeSchema.description: A condition that checks an item query against an inclusive quantity range.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this selected-drop rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this selected-drop rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a disable veto for the selected drop.

DropRuleDisableSchema.description: A rule that disables a selected drop when its conditions pass.

chance.description: The probability that this roll provides its output, from 0 to 1 inclusive.

drop.description: One or more items emitted when this roll succeeds.

RollChanceSchema.description: A roll that provides its output according to a probability.

ChanceSchema.description: A probability from zero to one inclusive.

quantity.description: The number of independent weighted selections made by this roll.

drop.description: At least two weighted drop candidates selected by this roll.

RollWeightSchema.description: A roll that selects its output according to relative item weights.

weight.description: The positive integer weight used to select this drop.

drop.description: One or more items emitted when this weighted drop is selected.

DropWeightSchema.description: Items and their relative weight in a weight-based output roll.

MergeSchema.description: A discriminated target-specific directional item merge.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

output.description: The optional extra output evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that keeps its selected target unchanged.

MergeKeepSchema.description: A merge that leaves its selected receiving item unchanged.

ActionEnumSchema.description: The action applied to a source item after it initiates a merge.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

output.description: The optional extra output evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that removes its selected target.

MergeRemoveSchema.description: A merge that removes its selected receiving item.

target.description: The selector that must match the receiving item for this merge to apply.

action.description: The action applied to the source item after this merge resolves.

output.description: The optional extra output evaluated after this merge resolves.

effect.description: Identifies this merge as one that replaces its selected target.

result.description: The canonical item that replaces the selected target.

MergeReplaceSchema.description: A merge that replaces its selected receiving item with an explicit result.

TimeSchema.description: A non-negative whole time value expressed in milliseconds.

InputSchema.description: A simple, material-item, or authored board-deposit input requirement for a product line.

charges.description: The optional charge cost paid by the line owner or this input's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as having no consumable resource requirement.

InputSimpleSchema.description: An explicit product-line input with no consumable resource requirement.

cost.description: The positive number of charges paid when this input starts one line job.

from.description: Whether the cost is paid by the line owner or the input's resolved target.

InputChargeSchema.description: One line-input charge cost and the runtime item that pays it.

InputChargeFromEnumSchema.description: Whether one input charge cost is paid by the line owner or its resolved target.

charges.description: The optional charge cost paid by the line owner or this input's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as a directly delivered material item.

selector.description: The canonical item accepted by this input.

mode.description: Whether this input is consumed or reserved; defaults to consume.

quantity.description: The exact or bounded total amount accepted across all matching materials.

capacity.description: The extra total quantity this input may buffer above its required quantity; defaults to zero, which allows no extra materials.

InputMaterialSchema.description: A directly delivered material item required by a product line.

InputModeEnumSchema.description: How an input item participates in a product line.

charges.description: The optional charge cost paid by the line owner or this input's resolved target.

type.description: Identifies this input as one external charged-item target on the board.

query.description: The board query used to select one charged target for this input.

InputDepositSchema.description: A board query that resolves one external charged-item target.

LineRuleSchema.description: A rule evaluated for a product line.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a request to show the product line.

LineRuleShowSchema.description: A rule that conditionally makes a product line visible.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a request to hide the product line.

LineRuleHideSchema.description: A rule that hides a product line when its condition is satisfied.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as an enable gate for the product line.

LineRuleEnableSchema.description: A rule that enables a product line when its conditions pass.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a disable veto for the product line.

LineRuleDisableSchema.description: A rule that disables a product line when its condition is satisfied.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a product-line runtime adjustment.

adjustMs.description: The signed millisecond adjustment added to this product line's runtime.

RuleRuntimeAdjustSchema.description: A rule that adjusts a product line's runtime by a signed millisecond value.

hint.description: Player-facing explanation shown while this product-line rule applies.

when.description: Conditions that must all pass for this product-line rule to apply.

type.description: Identifies this rule as a product-line runtime multiplier.

multiplier.description: The positive factor multiplied into this product line's runtime.

RuleRuntimeMultiplierSchema.description: A rule that multiplies a product line's runtime when its conditions pass.

id.description: The stable ID of this product line within its owning item.

title.description: The human-readable title of this product line.

description.description: The human-readable explanation of this product line's purpose.

default.description: Whether this line is the authored fallback default for its owning item.

show.description: Whether this product line is visible before its rules are evaluated.

enable.description: Whether this product line is enabled before its rules are evaluated.

runtimeMs.description: The runtime of this product line in milliseconds; zero completes immediately.

input.description: One or more input requirements for this product line.

output.description: The optional result produced when this product line completes.

rules.description: Rules that can change this product line's visibility, availability, or behavior.

LineSchema.description: A single product line with its accepted inputs and produced output.
